title_en: Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation: 2027 Scholarship Recommendation Call
summary: Korean nationals expected to register for the first semester of their third year in Spring 2027 who wish to be recommended for the Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation's 2027 scholarship should complete the Excel recommendation form and send it to the department office by 26 October 2026 (Monday). Departments will be notified of the final College of Engineering nominee on 28 October 2026 (Wednesday) at 15:00. The nominee must then submit all required documents to the department office by 29 October (Thursday) at 17:00.
applies_to: Optional (voluntary application). Open only to holders of Republic of Korea nationality who are expected to register for the first semester of their third year as of Spring 2027, and who meet all three requirements: completed at least 12 credits in every regular semester; an overall percentage grade of 85 or higher across all semesters; and no disciplinary record under the university regulations (including academic discipline). Each department may recommend at most one student; the College of Engineering will recommend one student.

conditions: All three eligibility requirements must be met: at least 12 credits in every regular semester, an overall percentage grade of 85 or higher, and no disciplinary record (including academic discipline).
Only holders of Republic of Korea nationality may be recommended.
Each department may recommend at most one student.
If no reply is received by the deadline, the department is treated as having no nominee.

If more students apply than can be recommended, students eligible for bonus points are selected first, and then nominees are chosen based on overall grades (grade point average and credits completed).
Submitting documents does not guarantee selection as the College of Engineering nominee or as the university's nominee.
Students with leadership experience or special talents receive bonus points in the document review; supporting evidence is required (see the foundation's official letter).

The nominee may be eliminated in the internal review by the Scholarship and Welfare Division, which plans to recommend two students; selection there is by highest bonus points first and then by academic excellence.
Final selection is by the foundation's document review and interview.
Documents should be completed on a PC and printed for readability; signatures must be handwritten.
The scholarship is either full tuition or an academic incentive of 3.5 million won, for up to 2 years (up to 4 regular semesters).
steps: Read the attachments: the foundation's official letter and guidance, the submission document forms and the recommendation form (the attachment contents were not read for this translation).
Complete the Excel scholarship recommendation form (장학생 추천서식) and send it to the department office by email by Monday, 26 October 2026 (the email address is in the original notice).
Wait for the department to be notified of the final College of Engineering nominee on Wednesday, 28 October 2026 at 15:00.

If selected as the nominee: prepare one copy each of the scholarship application, academic advisor's recommendation letter, personal statement, academic transcript, consent form for collection, use and provision of personal information (foundation and university), consent form for participation in scholarship obligations, and evidence for preferential criteria (only if applicable), filling them in on a PC, printing them and signing by hand.
If selected as the nominee: submit these documents to the department office by email by Thursday, 29 October 2026 at 17:00 (the email address is in the original notice).
If recommended onward, undergo the foundation's document review and interview.
translation:
2027 Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation Scholarship Selection Notice

The Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation is selecting new scholarship recipients for the 2027 academic year as follows. We encourage your interest and applications.

A. Eligible for recommendation: Holders of Republic of Korea nationality who are expected to register for the first semester of their third year as of Spring 2027.

B. Number of recommendations: Up to 1 per department. ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend 1 student.

C. Eligibility: Students who meet all three of the following:
1) Completed at least 12 credits in every regular semester
2) Overall percentage grade of 85 or higher across all semesters
3) No disciplinary record under the university regulations (including academic discipline)
※ Preferential criteria: Students with leadership activity experience and those with special talents receive bonus points in the document review (refer to the foundation's official letter).

D. Scholarship amount: Full tuition or an academic incentive of 3.5 million won.

E. Payment period: Up to 2 years (up to 4 regular semesters).

F. College of Engineering nominee selection procedure
1) Deadline and method: Complete the Excel scholarship recommendation form and send it to the department office by Monday, 26 October 2026 ([email]; the contact is in the original notice).
※ Each department recommends at most 1 student; if no reply is received by the deadline, the department is deemed to have no nominee.
※ If applications exceed the number of recommendations (1), students eligible for bonus points will be selected first, and nominees will be chosen by evaluation based on overall grades (grade point average and credits completed).
※ Regardless of document submission, you may not be selected as the College of Engineering nominee or the university's nominee.
2) Notification of the final nominee to departments: Wednesday, 28 October 2026, 15:00.
3) Document submission by the final nominee: one copy each of the scholarship application, academic advisor's recommendation letter, personal statement, academic transcript, consent form for collection, use and provision of personal information (foundation and university), consent form for participation in scholarship obligations, and evidence for preferential criteria (applicable students only), to be submitted to the department office ([email]) by Thursday, 29 October, 17:00.
※ For readability, please fill in the documents on a PC and print them (except signatures).

G. Selection method: Foundation document review and interview.
※ Considering the number of university recommendations, nominees may be eliminated in the internal review of the Scholarship and Welfare Division (which plans to recommend 2 students); selection will be in the order of highest bonus points (1st priority) and academic excellence (2nd priority).

Attachments:
1. Foundation official letter and guidance, 1 copy.
2. Submission document forms, 1 copy each.
3. Scholarship recommendation form, 1 copy.

Attached files (4):

- 2027년도 장학생 추천 안내문.pdf (116 KB) [2027 scholarship recommendation guidance]
- 2027년도 제출서류 양식.zip (237 KB) [2027 submission document forms]
- 개인정보 수집·이용 및 제공 동의서(장학복지과_교외재단).hwp (18 KB) [Consent form for collection, use and provision of personal information]

(Note: The contents of the attached files were not read for this translation. The department office's email address is given in the original notice.)
